title: Flash SegaSaturn: Ochikazuki-hen
native_title: フラッシュ・セガサターン ～おちかづき編～
overview:
Powerful software drawing ever closer. Fast approaching with outrageous fun!!

Flash SegaSaturn: Ochikazuki-hen is a not-for-sale preview disc from Sega that samples upcoming Saturn titles.

- Bomberman SS - playable
- Sakura Taisen - demo video
- Tengai Makyou: Daiyon no Mokushiroku - demo video
- Dennou Senki Virtual On - CG portraits

どんどん近づく強力ソフト。とんでもない面白さで急・接・近!!
